question: A transactional database on EC2 needs persistent block storage with consistently low latency and high provisioned random I/O performance. The database software manages its own files and cannot use an object-storage API. Which storage option is the best fit?

options.text: Amazon EBS st1 volumes sized for the same capacity
options.explanation: st1 berorientasi throughput HDD untuk akses sekuensial, bukan pilihan utama untuk random I/O transaksi yang sangat sensitif terhadap latensi.

options.text: EC2 instance store volumes with no external replication
options.explanation: Instance store dapat cepat, tetapi tidak memenuhi kebutuhan data persisten ketika instance dihentikan atau perangkat gagal.

options.text: Amazon S3 Standard accessed through a file-system adapter
options.explanation: Adapter tidak mengubah object storage menjadi pengganti block device database dengan karakteristik I/O yang diminta.

options.text: Amazon EBS io2 Block Express volumes on compatible EC2 instances
options.explanation: io2 Block Express menyediakan block storage dengan provisioned IOPS untuk beban transaksi yang sensitif terhadap latensi. Kompatibilitas dan kemampuan instance tetap harus diperiksa.

question: An HPC application running on a Linux EC2 cluster repeatedly processes a large dataset stored in S3. It requires a shared POSIX file system with high parallel throughput and integration with the S3 dataset. Which service should the architect evaluate first?

options.text: Amazon FSx for Lustre linked to the S3 dataset
options.explanation: FSx for Lustre ditujukan untuk parallel file processing berperforma tinggi dan dapat menghubungkan file system dengan dataset S3.

options.text: Amazon S3 File Gateway with its cache hosted on a small gateway instance
options.explanation: File Gateway ditujukan untuk akses file hybrid dengan cache lokal; bukan parallel file system HPC yang diprioritaskan di sini.

options.text: One EBS volume attached to a file-server instance used by the entire cluster
options.explanation: File server tunggal menambah administrasi dan dapat menjadi bottleneck; opsi ini tidak menyediakan kemampuan parallel managed file system yang diminta.

options.text: Amazon EFS selected only because it supports NFS
options.explanation: EFS menyediakan shared file storage, tetapi kebutuhan parallel HPC dan integrasi dataset S3 pada soal lebih spesifik cocok dengan FSx for Lustre.

question: A company is moving a Windows application to AWS without changing its file-access code. The application uses SMB shares, Windows access control lists, and Microsoft Active Directory identities. Which managed storage service best matches these requirements?

options.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
options.explanation: Layanan ini menyediakan Windows file shares melalui SMB dan integrasi Active Directory untuk izin file Windows.

options.text: Amazon S3 exposed directly to the application as object URLs
options.explanation: Object URLs bukan SMB shares dan mengharuskan perubahan pola akses aplikasi.

options.text: Amazon EFS with an NFS mount target for each server
options.explanation: EFS menggunakan NFS; aplikasi yang tetap membutuhkan SMB dan Windows ACL tidak cocok dengan opsi ini tanpa perubahan tambahan.

options.text: Amazon FSx for Lustre with an S3 data repository association
options.explanation: Lustre berfokus pada parallel Linux/HPC, bukan Windows SMB dan Windows ACL pada soal.

question: A client uploads multi-gigabyte objects to S3 over an unreliable connection. Restarting an entire upload after a connection failure wastes time. Which approach improves throughput and limits the amount of data that must be retransmitted?

options.text: Use S3 multipart upload and retry only failed parts before completing the upload
options.explanation: Multipart memungkinkan bagian diunggah paralel dan bagian gagal diulang tanpa mengirim ulang seluruh objek.

options.text: Enable Cross-Region Replication before the client uploads the object
options.explanation: Replication bekerja setelah data tersedia untuk direplikasi; bukan mekanisme upload client yang dapat dilanjutkan per bagian.

options.text: Use a single PUT request and increase the object retention period
options.explanation: Retention mengatur penyimpanan, bukan pemulihan bagian transfer yang gagal.

options.text: Enable S3 Versioning and repeat the entire single-request upload on each failure
options.explanation: Versioning melindungi versi objek, tetapi tidak menghindari pengulangan seluruh request upload.

question: A company has an on-premises NFS dataset and sufficient network bandwidth to copy it to S3. It needs an initial transfer followed by scheduled transfers of changed files, with managed task reporting and data verification. Which solution minimizes custom transfer code?

options.text: Mount S3 File Gateway and assume it will automatically discover and migrate the existing NFS server
options.explanation: File Gateway menyediakan file shares tersendiri; memasangnya bukan task migrasi otomatis seluruh server NFS yang sudah ada.

options.text: Configure an AWS DataSync task between the NFS location and S3
options.explanation: DataSync dirancang untuk transfer data, termasuk task terjadwal dan verifikasi sesuai opsi yang dipilih.

options.text: Use AWS DMS to copy the NFS directory tree as database tables
options.explanation: DMS ditujukan untuk migrasi database, bukan transfer file tree NFS umum ke S3.

options.text: Enable S3 Cross-Region Replication with the NFS server as its source
options.explanation: S3 replication bekerja antara sumber dan tujuan S3 yang didukung, bukan server NFS sebagai bucket sumber.

question: An on-premises application must continue accessing files through SMB. Recently accessed data should be cached locally, while the durable objects are stored in S3. Which solution meets this ongoing hybrid-access requirement?

options.text: Deploy Amazon S3 File Gateway and configure an SMB file share
options.explanation: File Gateway mempertahankan antarmuka file untuk aplikasi lokal sambil menyimpan data sebagai objek S3 dan menyediakan cache lokal.

options.text: Schedule AWS DataSync every night and point the application at its task ARN
options.explanation: DataSync memindahkan data; task ARN bukan SMB share yang dapat digunakan aplikasi.

options.text: Enable an S3 gateway VPC endpoint in the AWS VPC and mount it from the application as a share
options.explanation: Gateway endpoint menyediakan rute privat ke S3 bagi jaringan VPC yang sesuai, bukan file server SMB atau cache on-premises.

options.text: Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration and use the accelerated endpoint as an SMB server
options.explanation: Transfer Acceleration mengoptimalkan transfer ke endpoint S3, bukan menyediakan protokol SMB.

question: A website has a predictable traffic surge at 09:00 every weekday. New EC2 instances take several minutes to initialize. Target tracking adds instances only after response times have already increased. Which change best addresses the start of the surge?

options.text: Add scheduled scaling to increase ready capacity before 09:00, while retaining target tracking for demand changes
options.explanation: Scheduled scaling mengantisipasi waktu lonjakan dan startup delay; target tracking masih berguna untuk penyesuaian setelahnya.

options.text: Set a longer scale-out cooldown so scaling decisions are less frequent
options.explanation: Menunda penambahan kapasitas justru tidak menyelesaikan keterlambatan startup.

options.text: Retain the current desired capacity and scale only after average CPU remains high for an hour
options.explanation: Respons yang lebih lambat memperpanjang kekurangan kapasitas pada awal lonjakan.

options.text: Decrease the health-check interval without changing desired capacity
options.explanation: Pemeriksaan lebih sering tidak menyiapkan kapasitas sebelum beban datang.

question: A tightly coupled HPC job needs very low latency between EC2 instances and accepts a single-Availability-Zone placement for one job run. Which placement strategy is most appropriate?

options.text: Use a partition placement group to maximize hardware separation between communicating nodes
options.explanation: Partition membantu distribusi fault domain, bukan tujuan utama latensi antar-node paling rendah.

options.text: Place each worker in a different Region and connect the VPCs
options.explanation: Jarak lintas Region bertentangan dengan kebutuhan komunikasi berlatensi sangat rendah.

options.text: Use a spread placement group across multiple Availability Zones
options.explanation: Spread meningkatkan pemisahan perangkat dan fault isolation, bukan kedekatan jaringan maksimal untuk job ini.

options.text: Use a cluster placement group with compatible instance types in one Availability Zone
options.explanation: Cluster placement mengelompokkan instance untuk meningkatkan karakteristik jaringan workload tightly coupled dalam satu AZ.

question: A latency-sensitive Lambda API has long initialization time. Traffic is expected during business hours, and the team is willing to pay to keep execution environments initialized. Which configuration directly addresses initialization-related latency?

options.text: Configure provisioned concurrency for the version or alias that receives the requests
options.explanation: Provisioned concurrency menyiapkan environment sebelum invocation sehingga mengurangi latensi inisialisasi untuk kapasitas yang disediakan.

options.text: Increase the function timeout while leaving initialization unchanged
options.explanation: Timeout yang lebih panjang tidak mengurangi waktu tunggu pengguna akibat inisialisasi.

options.text: Increase asynchronous retry attempts for this synchronous API
options.explanation: Retry asynchronous tidak menyelesaikan cold initialization pada jalur request sinkron.

options.text: Configure only reserved concurrency for the function
options.explanation: Reserved concurrency mencadangkan dan membatasi concurrency, tetapi tidak dengan sendirinya memanaskan execution environment.

question: A company has a containerized processing program that runs continuously for two hours per job. The program cannot currently be split into shorter steps. The team wants to avoid managing worker EC2 instances. Which execution option best fits?

options.text: Run the entire program in one standard Lambda invocation with a two-hour timeout
options.explanation: Invocation Lambda biasa tidak mendukung timeout dua jam; mengganti nilai timeout tidak menghapus batas layanan.

options.text: Run each job as an Amazon ECS task on AWS Fargate
options.explanation: Fargate menjalankan container tanpa pengguna mengelola host EC2 dan cocok untuk job yang lebih panjang daripada invocation Lambda biasa.

options.text: Run the program inside an API Gateway integration and keep the HTTP request open
options.explanation: API Gateway bukan runtime umum untuk proses container dua jam; memegang request bukan orkestrasi batch yang tepat.

options.text: Configure Step Functions to execute the container code directly without a compute service
options.explanation: Step Functions mengorkestrasi task; layanan tersebut tidak mengeksekusi kode container tanpa layanan compute terkait.

question: A company needs to queue containerized model-training jobs that require NVIDIA GPUs. It wants managed batch scheduling and must choose a compute environment that can supply GPU resources. Which solution should it use?

options.text: AWS Batch with an EC2 compute environment using supported GPU instance types
options.explanation: Batch mengatur antrean/scheduling, sedangkan compute environment EC2 dapat menyediakan hardware GPU yang dibutuhkan.

options.text: An ECS service on Fargate with a larger memory reservation
options.explanation: Memori lebih besar bukan pengganti dukungan hardware GPU.

options.text: AWS Batch with a Fargate compute environment and a GPU requirement in every job
options.explanation: Fargate tidak menyediakan GPU untuk kebutuhan Batch ini; menambahkan deklarasi GPU tidak membuat hardware tersedia.

options.text: A standard Lambda function with additional ephemeral storage instead of a GPU
options.explanation: Ephemeral storage menambah ruang disk, bukan akselerator GPU.

question: An EC2 service frequently runs out of memory while CPU utilization remains low. The service cannot be horizontally scaled yet. Before committing to a long-term purchase, which actions best support a better instance choice? Select TWO.

options.text: Purchase a three-year commitment for the existing size before measuring the workload
options.explanation: Komitmen sebelum evaluasi dapat mengunci biaya konfigurasi yang tidak sesuai.

options.text: Evaluate a memory-optimized instance family using the actual application workload
options.explanation: Family memory-optimized sesuai hipotesis bottleneck RAM, tetapi harus diuji dengan workload nyata.

options.text: Collect representative memory and performance metrics, including peak periods
options.explanation: Data yang mencakup puncak dibutuhkan agar rekomendasi tidak hanya didasarkan pada CPU rata-rata.

options.text: Move to a compute-optimized instance solely because CPU utilization is low
options.explanation: CPU rendah tidak menunjukkan kebutuhan CPU lebih tinggi; rasio memori justru menjadi fokus masalah.

options.text: Reduce memory because low CPU always means the entire instance is oversized
options.explanation: Bottleneck memori dapat terjadi ketika CPU rendah; metrik satu dimensi tidak cukup.

question: An RDS PostgreSQL database has a large number of read-only product-catalog queries. Customers can tolerate a short delay before catalog updates appear. The primary instance is constrained by read load. Which change most directly offloads those reads?

options.text: Increase automated-backup retention to distribute read queries across backup copies
options.explanation: Backup bukan endpoint query aktif untuk membagi beban aplikasi.

options.text: Convert to a Multi-AZ DB instance with one standby and send catalog queries to that standby
options.explanation: Standby dari deployment ini tidak melayani read traffic; manfaatnya availability, bukan read scaling.

options.text: Add RDS Proxy and assume all repeated SELECT statements will be cached automatically
options.explanation: RDS Proxy mengelola koneksi, bukan query result cache yang menghilangkan biaya SELECT tersebut.

options.text: Create a read replica and route eligible catalog queries to its endpoint
options.explanation: Read replica mengalihkan query baca dari primary. Toleransi lag membuat asynchronous replication sesuai dengan kebutuhan ini.

question: An Aurora cluster has several reader instances. An application opens one long-lived connection to the reader endpoint and sends all read queries over that connection. One reader remains much busier than the others. What should the architect account for?

options.text: The reader endpoint balances only write statements, so all SELECT queries must use the writer endpoint
options.explanation: Endpoint reader digunakan untuk read connections; memindahkan semua SELECT ke writer bukan solusi read distribution.

options.text: The reader endpoint sends every query to every reader and selects the fastest result
options.explanation: Reader endpoint bukan mekanisme speculative execution yang mengeksekusi tiap query di semua reader.

options.text: Increase the number of reader instances while keeping the single connection and expecting it to migrate between them per query.
options.explanation: Menambah reader tidak mengubah balancing level koneksi; satu koneksi tetap tidak otomatis berpindah per query.

options.text: The reader endpoint balances connections; use an appropriate pool of connections rather than expecting per-query balancing on one connection
options.explanation: Reader endpoint mendistribusikan koneksi. Semua query dalam koneksi yang sama tidak otomatis dibagi ke semua reader.

question: A Lambda-based API creates many short-lived connections to an RDS database during bursts. Queries are individually fast, but connection creation and connection limits cause failures. Which service addresses this bottleneck with the least application-side pooling infrastructure?

options.text: Amazon RDS Proxy between the application and the database
options.explanation: RDS Proxy menyediakan pengelolaan dan penggunaan ulang koneksi database sehingga cocok untuk lonjakan koneksi dari aplikasi serverless.

options.text: Increase only the database connection timeout without changing pooling or connection volume.
options.explanation: Timeout lebih lama tidak mengurangi churn atau jumlah koneksi yang dibutuhkan saat burst.

options.text: An additional RDS read replica without changing the connection behavior of writes
options.explanation: Replica dapat membantu read load, tetapi tidak langsung menyelesaikan churn koneksi ke writer yang dijelaskan.

options.text: Increase Lambda concurrency while keeping one new direct database connection per invocation.
options.explanation: Ini dapat menambah tekanan connection limit yang sudah menjadi bottleneck, bukan mengelola pool koneksi.

question: An order service stores records in DynamoDB. Its most common request retrieves one customer's orders within a date range. Traffic is spread across a large number of customers. Which primary-key design best supports this access pattern without a table scan?

options.text: Use the current month as the partition key and omit customerId from all keys
options.explanation: Partition bulanan tidak langsung memberi query per pelanggan tanpa membaca data pelanggan lain.

options.text: Use customerId as the partition key and orderTimestamp plus a unique order identifier as the sort key
options.explanation: Query dapat menentukan customerId dan rentang sort key. Identifier tambahan menghindari benturan jika waktu order sama.

options.text: Use one constant partition key for every order and a random sort key
options.explanation: Satu key konstan memusatkan workload dan sort key acak tidak mendukung rentang waktu yang diminta.

options.text: Use a random partition key for each order and keep customerId as a non-key attribute only
options.explanation: Query pelanggan akan membutuhkan index tambahan atau scan karena customerId bukan key yang dapat ditargetkan pada desain ini.

question: A DynamoDB table uses orderId as its partition key. A new feature must efficiently find orders by customerId, and a short delay before new orders appear in that view is acceptable. Which change enables this access pattern?

options.text: Use a Scan with a customerId filter and assume the filter avoids reading unrelated items
options.explanation: Filter scan tidak mengubah operasi tersebut menjadi Query pada partition key; item tetap dibaca sebelum penyaringan yang relevan.

options.text: Add a local secondary index whose partition key is customerId instead of orderId
options.explanation: LSI mempertahankan partition key tabel; tidak menyediakan partition key baru customerId.

options.text: Add an index that retains orderId as its partition key and stores customerId only as a projected non-key attribute.
options.explanation: Projected attribute bukan key yang dapat ditargetkan Query untuk pola customerId; masih belum menyediakan alternate partition key.

options.text: Add a global secondary index with customerId as its partition key and an appropriate sort key
options.explanation: GSI menyediakan key alternatif di luar partition key tabel. Toleransi keterlambatan cocok dengan karakteristik eventual consistency GSI.

question: A DynamoDB application repeatedly reads the same reference items and can tolerate eventually consistent cached results. The team wants a managed cache that integrates with DynamoDB access. Which option is the closest fit?

options.text: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)
options.explanation: DAX ditujukan untuk akselerasi pola baca DynamoDB melalui cache dan sesuai untuk read yang dapat menerima hasil eventually consistent.

options.text: Enable strongly consistent reads for all requests to force DAX cache hits
options.explanation: Strongly consistent reads tidak dilayani sebagai cache hit DAX; pola ini tidak mencapai tujuan caching yang diminta.

options.text: Add a global secondary index with the same keys solely to cache every GetItem response
options.explanation: GSI menyediakan jalur index, bukan cache transparan untuk request GetItem yang sama.

options.text: Increase write capacity only, without changing the repeated-read access path.
options.explanation: Penambahan kapasitas write tidak menghilangkan repeated read work atau memberikan cache.

question: A product service uses ElastiCache with a cache-aside pattern. Product descriptions may be stale for up to five minutes. Which design balances lower database load with that bounded caching policy?

options.text: Store every product record only in the cache and remove the durable database copy
options.explanation: Cache bukan otomatis pengganti sumber data durable; kehilangan cache dapat menghilangkan data.

options.text: Keep product records in cache forever and refresh only when the cache cluster restarts
options.explanation: Tidak ada batas staleness lima menit pada pola ini.

options.text: Cache product records with an appropriate TTL, populate on misses, and invalidate relevant keys when product updates are processed
options.explanation: TTL dan invalidation memberi batas serta jalur penyegaran. Cache miss tetap mengambil data dari database sebagai sumber kebenaran.

options.text: Read the database for every request and never reuse cached responses
options.explanation: Cara ini tidak mencapai tujuan mengurangi beban database lewat cache.

question: A multi-tenant API caches responses under keys such as invoice:123. Different tenants can use the same invoice number. Users sometimes receive another tenant's cached response. Which changes are necessary? Select TWO.

options.text: Perform authorization for the requesting user before returning the cached invoice
options.explanation: Cache hit tidak menghapus kewajiban otorisasi; akses harus tetap diperiksa untuk data yang diminta.

options.text: Use a larger cache node while retaining the same keys and authorization behavior
options.explanation: Kapasitas bukan akar masalah kebocoran data antar-tenant.

options.text: Include the tenant identity in the cache key and other dimensions that change the response
options.explanation: Tenant harus menjadi bagian identitas key agar objek milik tenant berbeda tidak bertabrakan.

options.text: Increase the cache TTL so each tenant's data stays cached longer
options.explanation: TTL lebih lama tidak menyelesaikan benturan key atau kontrol akses.

options.text: Cache only the first tenant's version of each invoice number
options.explanation: Menyimpan satu versi global tetap salah ketika tenant memiliki nomor yang sama.

question: An account-management operation must read the latest committed balance immediately after updating it. The existing read path uses an asynchronously refreshed cache. Which design best preserves this operation's correctness?

options.text: Serve whichever value is returned fastest from the cache or database
options.explanation: Memilih hasil tercepat tanpa aturan konsistensi dapat mengembalikan saldo lama.

options.text: Increase the cache TTL so the balance stays available longer
options.explanation: TTL lebih panjang dapat memperpanjang staleness, bukan membuat data terbaru tersedia.

options.text: Add more cache replicas and assume replication guarantees the newest database value
options.explanation: Replica cache tidak memperbaiki lag antara database dan cache secara otomatis.

options.text: Use the authoritative data store with the required consistency for this operation, while keeping caching for eligible stale-tolerant reads
options.explanation: Jalur kritis harus memenuhi konsistensi yang diperlukan. Cache masih dapat digunakan untuk bagian lain yang toleran terhadap staleness.

question: A web platform uses one HTTPS hostname. Requests under /orders must reach one ECS service, while /catalog requests must reach another. TLS can terminate at the load balancer. Which solution provides this routing natively?

options.text: A Network Load Balancer with a listener rule that matches HTTP path strings
options.explanation: NLB bekerja pada layer-4 dan tidak menyediakan path-based HTTP listener rules seperti ALB.

options.text: An Application Load Balancer with path-based listener rules and separate target groups
options.explanation: ALB memahami HTTP path sehingga dapat merutekan request ke target group layanan terkait.

options.text: Route 53 records that choose a target based on the URL path after the hostname
options.explanation: DNS menentukan nama host, bukan path HTTP di dalam request.

options.text: A Gateway Load Balancer that selects application targets from URL paths
options.explanation: GWLB ditujukan untuk network appliances, bukan routing URL aplikasi.

question: A service accepts UDP traffic. Enterprise clients require fixed IP addresses to allowlist the service endpoint, and targets must be distributed across Availability Zones. Which load balancer is most appropriate?

options.text: A Gateway Load Balancer configured as a general-purpose public UDP application endpoint
options.explanation: GWLB menyediakan alur virtual appliances melalui mekanisme khusus, bukan pilihan umum untuk endpoint aplikasi UDP publik ini.

options.text: An internet-facing Network Load Balancer with static addresses, using Elastic IP addresses where required
options.explanation: NLB mendukung UDP serta static IP per enabled AZ; EIP dapat digunakan untuk alamat yang dikelola pada skenario internet-facing yang didukung.

options.text: An Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener
options.explanation: ALB tidak melayani UDP hanya dengan konfigurasi listener HTTPS.

options.text: A Route 53 alias to changing EC2 public IP addresses without a load balancer
options.explanation: Alias/DNS tidak dengan sendirinya menyediakan fixed load-balanced endpoint atau health-based target distribution yang diminta.

question: A security team uses third-party virtual inspection appliances. It needs a managed way to distribute network traffic across a fleet of these appliances and insert them into VPC traffic paths. Which service best fits?

options.text: Amazon CloudFront with an appliance configured as a cache behavior
options.explanation: CloudFront adalah layanan delivery/cache HTTP, bukan mekanisme penyisipan appliance pada jalur VPC umum.

options.text: AWS Gateway Load Balancer
options.explanation: GWLB dirancang untuk men-deploy, menskalakan, dan mengintegrasikan virtual network appliances dalam jalur traffic.

options.text: An Application Load Balancer with host-based rules for every IP packet
options.explanation: ALB bukan load balancer transparan untuk seluruh protokol network traffic menuju appliance.

options.text: Route 53 weighted records pointing to appliance management interfaces without a traffic-insertion mechanism.
options.explanation: DNS ke management endpoints bukan penyisipan dan distribusi traffic transparan melalui inspection appliance fleet.

question: A company serves the same versioned images and JavaScript files to users worldwide from an S3 origin. It wants to reduce repeat origin requests and improve delivery latency. Which solution best fits?

options.text: Replicate assets to another Region but keep every viewer requesting the original endpoint without cache or routing changes.
options.explanation: Replikasi tidak dimanfaatkan oleh request path yang masih sama dan tidak mengurangi repeat origin requests.

options.text: Use CloudFront with cacheable object responses and appropriate cache policies
options.explanation: CloudFront menyimpan konten yang dapat di-cache dekat pengguna dan mengurangi request berulang ke origin.

options.text: Use Global Accelerator as an object cache in front of the S3 bucket
options.explanation: Global Accelerator tidak menyediakan object caching seperti CloudFront.

options.text: Use Route 53 latency routing to the same single S3 origin without a cache
options.explanation: DNS routing sendiri tidak menyimpan respons dekat pengguna atau menghilangkan repeat origin fetch.

question: A real-time application uses UDP and runs behind regional Network Load Balancers in two AWS Regions. Customers must allowlist a stable global set of IP addresses. Which service can provide those addresses and route traffic to healthy regional endpoints?

options.text: A single Regional NAT gateway used as a public inbound load balancer
options.explanation: NAT gateway ditujukan untuk koneksi keluar yang sesuai, bukan public inbound global application load balancing.

options.text: Route 53 latency routing alone, because its answers are fixed global anycast application IPs
options.explanation: Route 53 memilih jawaban DNS; layanan ini tidak dengan sendirinya menyediakan static anycast application IP seperti Global Accelerator.

options.text: AWS Global Accelerator with the regional load balancers as endpoints
options.explanation: Global Accelerator mendukung static anycast IP dan endpoint regional untuk traffic TCP/UDP yang sesuai.

options.text: Amazon CloudFront configured to cache the UDP packets
options.explanation: CloudFront bukan layanan general-purpose UDP packet delivery/cache.

question: A hybrid environment needs on-premises clients to resolve names in a VPC-associated private hosted zone. EC2 clients also need to resolve a corporate domain hosted on on-premises DNS servers. Which components support both directions? Select TWO.

options.text: An inbound endpoint alone, without an outbound rule, for all queries from EC2 to corporate DNS
options.explanation: Inbound endpoint tidak menggantikan outbound forwarding untuk domain yang di-host di on-premises.

options.text: Only an internet gateway, because it automatically replicates private hosted zones to on-premises DNS
options.explanation: Internet gateway tidak mereplikasi zona DNS privat atau menyediakan conditional forwarding.

options.text: Resolver outbound endpoints and forwarding rules for the corporate domain
options.explanation: Outbound endpoint dan rules meneruskan query dari VPC ke DNS korporat yang berwenang.

options.text: A public hosted zone containing the same private records, without access controls
options.explanation: Mempublikasikan record bukan solusi hybrid private resolution yang diminta dan dapat mengekspos informasi.

options.text: Resolver inbound endpoints, with on-premises DNS forwarding the AWS private domain to them
options.explanation: Inbound endpoint menerima query dari jaringan on-premises menuju VPC Resolver untuk domain privat yang relevan.

question: A company has dozens of VPCs with non-overlapping CIDRs. Most require access to shared services and an on-premises network. Maintaining a full mesh of peering connections has become difficult. Which design provides a managed hub-and-spoke routing model?

options.text: Use one central peered VPC as a router for all other peered VPCs without a supported transit service.
options.explanation: Peering tidak transitif; central topology visual saja tidak menyediakan transit routing.

options.text: Connect the VPCs and supported on-premises attachments through AWS Transit Gateway and configure its route tables
options.explanation: Transit Gateway menyediakan hub routing dan route tables untuk banyak attachment, mengurangi kompleksitas full-mesh.

options.text: Add one more VPC peering connection and assume all existing peers become transitively connected
options.explanation: Peering tidak transitif, sehingga satu koneksi tambahan tidak membuat semua peer dapat melewati hub secara otomatis.

options.text: Create separate interface endpoints for unrelated AWS services and treat them as general VPC-to-VPC routes.
options.explanation: Interface endpoints menghubungkan layanan yang dipublikasikan, bukan general routed hub untuk seluruh CIDR dan on-premises connectivity.

question: VPC A is peered with VPC B, and VPC B is peered with VPC C. A service in A must communicate with a service in C. The team adds routes through B but traffic still cannot pass. Which explanation and remedy are correct?

options.text: A security-group reference across one peering connection creates a network route to every other peer.
options.explanation: Security-group authorization tidak menciptakan routing transit yang tidak didukung.

options.text: VPC peering is non-transitive; create a direct A-to-C peering connection or use a supported transit design
options.explanation: Peering A-B dan B-C tidak membentuk transit A-C. Konektivitas langsung atau layanan transit yang sesuai diperlukan.

options.text: VPC peering is transitive whenever all three VPCs use non-overlapping CIDRs.
options.explanation: Non-overlapping CIDR adalah syarat relevan tetapi tidak mengubah sifat non-transitive peering.

options.text: An accepted peering request automatically propagates all routes through every other peer.
options.explanation: Peering tidak otomatis membentuk route propagation transit melalui VPC B.

question: A web application has equivalent deployments in two AWS Regions. It uses DNS-based routing and wants users directed toward the Region expected to provide lower network latency. Which Route 53 policy is most appropriate?

options.text: Geolocation routing, because the nearest country always has the lowest network latency
options.explanation: Geolocation memilih berdasarkan lokasi pengguna, bukan jaminan rute dengan latensi terendah.

options.text: Weighted routing with equal weights, because it measures each user's live response time
options.explanation: Weighted routing membagi berdasarkan bobot, bukan mengukur response time setiap user untuk pemilihan tersebut.

options.text: Failover routing with one permanent primary, regardless of latency
options.explanation: Failover berfokus pada primary/secondary health, bukan memilih deployment berlatensi lebih rendah saat keduanya sehat.

options.text: Latency-based routing, with health evaluation configured as appropriate
options.explanation: Latency routing menggunakan pengukuran latensi AWS untuk memilih Region yang relevan; health evaluation perlu dirancang agar endpoint gagal tidak diprioritaskan.

question: A company ingests click events. Two applications must independently process the stream, and each must be able to replay retained events after fixing a processing bug. Which service is the best match for this custom stream-consumer design?

options.text: One SQS queue shared by both applications so every event is guaranteed to reach both
options.explanation: Consumer pada satu queue bersaing mengambil pekerjaan; pola itu tidak memberikan salinan independen setiap event ke kedua aplikasi.

options.text: Amazon Data Firehose alone, treating it as a general-purpose consumer-controlled replay log
options.explanation: Firehose berfokus pada delivery terkelola; bukan pengganti umum stream replay yang consumer baca dengan checkpoint sendiri.

options.text: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with appropriate retention and separate consumers
options.explanation: Data Streams menyediakan retained stream yang dapat dibaca consumer independen dan di-replay selama data masih dalam retention.

options.text: An SNS topic with no subscriptions or durable downstream storage
options.explanation: Topic tanpa subscriber tidak menyediakan pipeline pemrosesan dan retained log yang dapat dibaca seperti yang diminta.

question: An application produces logs that must be delivered to S3. A buffering delay is acceptable, and the team does not need to build custom stream consumers. Which service reduces operational effort for the delivery pipeline?

options.text: Amazon Data Firehose with S3 as the destination
options.explanation: Firehose menyediakan buffering dan delivery terkelola ke S3 sehingga tim tidak perlu membangun consumer delivery sendiri.

options.text: Kinesis Data Streams without any consumer that writes to S3
options.explanation: Membuat stream saja tidak melaksanakan delivery data ke S3.

options.text: An EventBridge bus with no configured target that writes the logs to S3.
options.explanation: Event bus tanpa delivery target/integrasi tidak melaksanakan penyimpanan log ke destination.

options.text: An SQS queue without a worker or integration that persists messages to S3
options.explanation: Queue menyimpan pesan untuk diproses; tanpa consumer/integrasi, delivery ke S3 tidak terjadi.

question: A company already uses Apache Kafka producers, consumers, and operational tooling. It wants to move to AWS while preserving Kafka protocol compatibility and reducing broker-management work. Which managed service should it evaluate?

options.text: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with the Kafka clients left unchanged
options.explanation: Kinesis bukan protokol Kafka; migrasi biasanya memerlukan adaptasi client atau integrasi.

options.text: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
options.explanation: MSK menyediakan layanan Kafka terkelola sehingga cocok untuk kebutuhan kompatibilitas Kafka yang eksplisit.

options.text: Amazon EventBridge with the existing Kafka broker addresses reused as event buses
options.explanation: EventBridge tidak otomatis berubah menjadi Kafka broker karena nama/alamat client dipertahankan.

options.text: Amazon SQS FIFO with no changes to Kafka clients
options.explanation: SQS memiliki API dan model konsumsi berbeda; bukan endpoint Kafka drop-in.

question: A company stores raw JSON events in S3. Analysts need cleaned, consistently typed Parquet datasets and discoverable table metadata. Which design provides both transformation and cataloging?

options.text: Use AWS Glue ETL jobs to transform the data and maintain table metadata in the Glue Data Catalog
options.explanation: ETL jobs melakukan transformasi; Data Catalog menyediakan metadata untuk penemuan dan query melalui layanan yang terkait.

options.text: Change the S3 object filename suffix from .json to .parquet without rewriting the file contents.
options.explanation: Nama file tidak mengubah encoding/struktur menjadi Parquet; transformasi data sebenarnya diperlukan.

options.text: Use the Glue Data Catalog to store metadata, but perform no transformation of the raw JSON content.
options.explanation: Cataloging menyediakan metadata tetapi tidak sendiri membersihkan tipe dan menulis dataset Parquet.

options.text: Run only a Glue crawler and assume it rewrites every JSON file as Parquet
options.explanation: Crawler menemukan schema/metadata; fungsi ini tidak otomatis melakukan ETL dan menulis semua data sebagai Parquet.

question: Athena queries read a large S3 dataset, but analysts usually request only a few columns for one day. Which changes can reduce unnecessary data scanned? Select TWO.

options.text: Combine all dates into one unpartitioned CSV object and always use SELECT *
options.explanation: Pola ini memperluas pembacaan kolom/baris yang tidak diperlukan.

options.text: Partition only by a random upload identifier that queries never filter on.
options.explanation: Partitioning yang tidak sesuai predicate query tidak membatasi scan ke tanggal yang relevan.

options.text: Partition by a useful date field and include that partition key in query predicates
options.explanation: Partition pruning membutuhkan layout dan query yang sesuai agar partisi di luar tanggal target dapat diabaikan.

options.text: Store the data in an appropriate compressed columnar format such as Parquet
options.explanation: Columnar memungkinkan pembacaan kolom yang relevan dan compression dapat mengurangi byte yang diproses.

options.text: Keep data as CSV and project all columns in every query, relying only on table metadata to skip bytes.
options.explanation: Metadata saja tidak memberi columnar pruning yang sama jika format dan query tetap membaca semua kolom.

question: A company wants a managed SQL data warehouse for complex analytical joins and aggregations across historical sales datasets. The warehouse is separate from the transactional checkout database. Which service best matches this role?

options.text: Amazon RDS optimized for short per-order OLTP transactions, selected solely because it also accepts SQL.
options.explanation: Kemampuan SQL tidak berarti karakteristik paling sesuai untuk warehouse analitik skala besar; workload pada soal adalah OLAP.

options.text: Amazon Redshift
options.explanation: Redshift ditujukan untuk data warehousing dan analytical SQL workloads, berbeda dari jalur transaksi checkout.

options.text: Amazon DynamoDB with no change to existing relational SQL queries
options.explanation: DynamoDB bukan pengganti transparan relational SQL warehouse dengan join kompleks.

options.text: Amazon OpenSearch Service chosen solely to avoid modeling the required relational joins and warehouse aggregations.
options.explanation: Search/analytics engine memiliki use case berbeda; penggantian tanpa desain untuk relational warehouse joins tidak memenuhi alasan pemilihan soal.

question: A company uses NetApp ONTAP snapshots and replication. Its migrated file service must support both Linux NFS clients and Windows SMB clients, with minimal change to those storage workflows. Which managed file system should it evaluate first?

options.text: Amazon S3 File Gateway as a replacement for all ONTAP volume features.
options.explanation: Gateway menyediakan antarmuka file ke objek tetapi tidak mempertahankan seluruh kemampuan volume ONTAP.

options.text: Amazon EFS with an SMB listener enabled.
options.explanation: EFS menyediakan NFS, bukan SMB native dan fitur administrasi ONTAP.

options.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server as an ONTAP replication target.
options.explanation: FSx Windows bukan sistem ONTAP meskipun cocok untuk SMB.

options.text: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP.
options.explanation: Layanan ini menyediakan kemampuan ONTAP serta akses multiprotokol; validasi versi dan fitur yang dibutuhkan.

question: A Linux development team wants NFS file storage with ZFS snapshots and fast writable clones of test datasets. It does not need SMB or a parallel HPC file system. Which service most directly preserves these capabilities?

options.text: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS.
options.explanation: OpenZFS menyediakan NFS serta snapshot dan cloning berbasis ZFS yang diminta.

options.text: Amazon EFS because all NFS systems expose ZFS clones.
options.explanation: Kesamaan protokol tidak berarti fitur penyimpanan ZFS ikut tersedia.

options.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server using its default SMB shares.
options.explanation: Antarmuka dan fitur yang dipilih tidak cocok dengan NFS/ZFS.

options.text: Amazon S3 with versioning as a native NFS volume.
options.explanation: Versioning objek bukan volume NFS dengan writable ZFS clone.

question: An application has an EBS volume provisioned for more throughput than its measured demand. Increasing the volume throughput again produces no improvement. Metrics show the EC2 instance has reached its aggregate EBS bandwidth limit. What should change first?

options.text: Increase only the provisioned volume throughput again.
options.explanation: Volume tidak dapat melewati batas agregat koneksi EBS instance.

options.text: Increase the snapshot retention period.
options.explanation: Retensi backup tidak meningkatkan bandwidth I/O instance.

options.text: Add an S3 gateway endpoint to the application subnet.
options.explanation: Jalur API S3 bukan jalur block I/O antara EC2 dan EBS.

options.text: Use an EC2 configuration with sufficient EBS bandwidth, then benchmark the complete I/O path.
options.explanation: Batas instance tetap membatasi volume; pengujian memastikan bottleneck tidak berpindah ke komponen lain.

question: A small EFS dataset experiences unpredictable bursts of file throughput. The team wants throughput that adjusts to activity rather than relying on credits accumulated from stored-data size. Which EFS throughput mode fits?

options.text: Elastic throughput, after checking workload suitability and cost.
options.explanation: Elastic menyesuaikan throughput dengan aktivitas tanpa mengandalkan ukuran data sebagai sumber burst credit.

options.text: General Purpose performance mode alone without choosing a throughput mode.
options.explanation: Performance mode dan throughput mode adalah keputusan berbeda.

options.text: Bursting throughput while reducing stored data as far as possible.
options.explanation: Bursting mengaitkan baseline dan credit dengan storage; mengecilkan data bukan solusi untuk kebutuhan ini.

options.text: Provisioned throughput fixed permanently at the largest imaginable peak.
options.explanation: Dapat memenuhi kapasitas tetapi tidak menyesuaikan otomatis dengan aktivitas seperti yang diminta.

question: A processing application needs several independent byte ranges from a very large S3 object. It currently downloads the entire object serially for every run. Which change can reduce unnecessary transfer and improve throughput?

options.text: Move the object to a colder archive tier before every read.
options.explanation: Restore dan akses arsip tidak mempercepat pembacaan aktif ini.

options.text: Use multipart upload to retrieve the existing object.
options.explanation: Multipart upload membagi pengiriman ke S3, bukan mekanisme membaca rentang objek.

options.text: Enable versioning so each GET returns only modified bytes.
options.explanation: Versioning menyimpan versi, tidak mengubah GET menjadi delta otomatis.

options.text: Use concurrent byte-range GET requests for the required ranges.
options.explanation: Aplikasi hanya mengambil rentang yang diperlukan dan dapat memparalelkan permintaan.

question: A tightly coupled MPI workload already runs in a cluster placement group on compatible EC2 instances. Communication latency still dominates. The application can use supported libfabric integration. What should the architect evaluate?

options.text: S3 Transfer Acceleration for MPI collective operations.
options.explanation: Fitur transfer objek bukan transport komunikasi antarproses MPI.

options.text: An internet-facing Application Load Balancer between MPI ranks.
options.explanation: ALB menangani HTTP dan bukan interkoneksi komunikasi MPI.

options.text: A NAT gateway for every MPI message.
options.explanation: Jalur translasi internet bukan optimasi komunikasi internal HPC.

options.text: Elastic Fabric Adapter with supported instances and software configuration.
options.explanation: EFA ditujukan untuk komunikasi antar-node HPC dengan integrasi software yang sesuai.

question: New EC2 workers need 12 minutes to initialize software. Traffic spikes are unpredictable, and creating an instance only after a spike misses the response target. Keeping every possible worker running is too costly. Which Auto Scaling feature can reduce initialization delay?

options.text: A scheduled scaling action at one fixed time each day only.
options.explanation: Lonjakan tidak memiliki jadwal yang dapat diandalkan.

options.text: A larger health-check grace period without preparing any capacity.
options.explanation: Grace period mencegah pemeriksaan terlalu dini tetapi tidak menghilangkan waktu inisialisasi.

options.text: A warm pool of preinitialized instances with an appropriate lifecycle and readiness checks.
options.explanation: Warm pool mempersiapkan instance sebelum dibutuhkan; biaya storage dan proses start tetap diperhitungkan.

options.text: A lower CPU alarm threshold while retaining the full 12-minute startup path.
options.explanation: Trigger lebih dini belum menjamin kesiapan menghadapi lonjakan tak terduga.

question: A Lambda function is CPU-bound and uses much less memory than its allocation. The team assumes reducing memory must reduce cost. Which experiment is most useful before deciding?

options.text: Increase the timeout only and assume execution becomes faster.
options.explanation: Timeout mengubah batas waktu, bukan kemampuan CPU.

options.text: Increase reserved concurrency to give each invocation more CPU.
options.explanation: Reserved concurrency membatasi atau menjamin jumlah invocation, bukan CPU per invocation.

options.text: Reduce memory to the smallest value because CPU allocation is independent of memory.
options.explanation: Asumsi independensi CPU dan memori tidak benar untuk Lambda.

options.text: Benchmark several memory allocations and compare duration, latency, and total compute cost.
options.explanation: Memori memengaruhi CPU yang tersedia; durasi yang berubah menentukan hasil biaya sebenarnya.

question: A team must keep Kubernetes deployment interfaces and run inference containers that require NVIDIA GPUs. It wants AWS to manage the control plane. Which combination is suitable?

options.text: Amazon ECS on Fargate while retaining Kubernetes operators unchanged.
options.explanation: Pilihan ini tidak mempertahankan Kubernetes API dan tidak menyediakan GPU Fargate.

options.text: Amazon EKS with suitable GPU-backed EC2 worker nodes.
options.explanation: EKS menyediakan control plane terkelola; worker EC2 yang sesuai menyediakan GPU.

options.text: Amazon EKS with CPU-only workers and a GPU limit in the pod manifest.
options.explanation: Deklarasi resource tidak menciptakan hardware GPU yang tidak tersedia.

options.text: Amazon EKS using only Fargate profiles for the GPU pods.
options.explanation: GPU tidak tersedia pada EKS Fargate dalam dokumentasi yang diperiksa.

question: A simulation has 2,000 independent parameter sets. Each run uses the same container image but a different index, and results are written to S3. Which design minimizes custom job scheduling code?

options.text: An ALB listener rule for each simulation parameter set.
options.explanation: Routing HTTP bukan scheduler pekerjaan batch.

options.text: A single EC2 startup script that treats all simulations as one inseparable job.
options.explanation: Kegagalan dan penjadwalan tetap harus dikelola sebagai pekerjaan besar sendiri.

options.text: One Lambda invocation that sequentially executes all simulations regardless of duration.
options.explanation: Pemrosesan serial tidak memanfaatkan independensi pekerjaan dan dibatasi durasi Lambda.

options.text: An AWS Batch array job that maps the child-job index to a parameter set.
options.explanation: Array job menjalankan banyak child job dengan indeks yang dapat dipakai memilih input.

question: A company is migrating a commercial relational database to Aurora PostgreSQL. It wants to identify incompatible schema objects and convert supported objects before moving production data. Which approach is appropriate?

options.text: Run DMS change data capture and assume it automatically rewrites every stored procedure.
options.explanation: CDC mereplikasi perubahan data; tidak menjamin konversi seluruh logika dan objek.

options.text: Assess and convert the schema with AWS DMS Schema Conversion, and resolve unsupported objects before replication.
options.explanation: Konversi heterogen perlu assessment dan perbaikan objek yang tidak dapat dikonversi otomatis.

options.text: Restore the source engine binary backup directly into Aurora PostgreSQL.
options.explanation: Backup native engine berbeda bukan format pemulihan langsung yang kompatibel.

options.text: Enable Multi-AZ on the source to convert its SQL dialect.
options.explanation: HA tidak mengubah dialek atau skema database.

question: A large database must move to a supported AWS target while the source continues accepting writes during most of the migration. A short final maintenance window is permitted. Which actions form an appropriate migration plan? Select TWO.

options.text: Delete source transaction logs before CDC reads them.
options.explanation: Log diperlukan untuk menangkap perubahan yang belum direplikasi.

options.text: At cutover, stop or redirect source writes, let replication catch up, validate, and switch the application.
options.explanation: Cutover terkontrol mencegah kehilangan perubahan terakhir dan split writing.

options.text: Immediately write to both independent databases without conflict handling.
options.explanation: Dual write tanpa desain konsistensi dapat membuat data berbeda.

options.text: Perform a full load with change data capture while monitoring replication health.
options.explanation: Full load membawa baseline dan CDC meneruskan perubahan yang terjadi selama migrasi.

options.text: Assume successful endpoint creation proves every table and application query is compatible.
options.explanation: Koneksi bukan bukti kompatibilitas skema, data, atau aplikasi.

question: A fraud system repeatedly explores several hops between accounts, devices, merchants, and shared addresses. Relationship traversal is the dominant query pattern. Which database category should the architect evaluate first?

options.text: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive queried interactively for every relationship.
options.explanation: Arsip dengan restore tidak cocok untuk query traversal interaktif.

options.text: Amazon ElastiCache as the only durable relationship system of record without persistence planning.
options.explanation: Cache saja tidak memenuhi kebutuhan sistem data utama yang dijelaskan.

options.text: Amazon Neptune graph databases.
options.explanation: Model graph cocok untuk hubungan dan traversal multi-hop yang menjadi operasi utama.

options.text: Amazon RDS solely because every relationship query must use SQL joins.
options.explanation: Relasional tetap mungkin, tetapi tidak menjadi pilihan paling langsung untuk kebutuhan graph dominan.

question: An application uses MongoDB drivers and a JSON-like document model. The team wants a managed AWS document database, but it uses several specialized commands. What is the sound selection approach?

options.text: Choose RDS PostgreSQL without evaluating the existing driver and command requirements.
options.explanation: Engine relasional tidak mempertahankan API MongoDB begitu saja.

options.text: Choose DocumentDB and skip compatibility tests because the engine is identical to MongoDB.
options.explanation: DocumentDB adalah layanan berbeda dengan cakupan kompatibilitas tertentu.

options.text: Choose Neptune because every JSON document is automatically a graph query.
options.explanation: Format dokumen tidak otomatis menunjukkan kebutuhan graph.

options.text: Evaluate Amazon DocumentDB and test the required API features and behavior before migration.
options.explanation: Kompatibilitas MongoDB tidak berarti seluruh fitur dan perilaku identik; pengujian aplikasi tetap wajib.

question: A workload uses Cassandra Query Language and supported Cassandra drivers. The company wants a managed AWS service rather than administering Cassandra nodes. Which service should be evaluated for compatibility?

options.text: Amazon DynamoDB as a native CQL endpoint without application changes.
options.explanation: DynamoDB menggunakan API dan model operasinya sendiri.

options.text: Amazon Keyspaces.
options.explanation: Keyspaces menyediakan layanan database kompatibel Cassandra; validasi fitur yang digunakan tetap diperlukan.

options.text: Amazon DocumentDB as a Cassandra wire-protocol implementation.
options.explanation: DocumentDB berorientasi kompatibilitas MongoDB, bukan CQL.

options.text: Amazon Neptune because all NoSQL protocols are interchangeable.
options.explanation: Kategori NoSQL tidak berarti protokolnya sama.

question: A product database is the transactional source of truth. Users need full-text search, relevance ranking, and aggregations over searchable fields. Which addition best fits?

options.text: A larger S3 object containing every product, downloaded for each query.
options.explanation: Membaca seluruh katalog per pencarian tidak memberi indeks pencarian yang sesuai.

options.text: A DynamoDB TTL attribute to rank documents by relevance.
options.explanation: TTL mengatur penghapusan item, bukan ranking teks.

options.text: An RDS standby used as a full-text relevance engine without changes.
options.explanation: Standby HA bukan otomatis indeks pencarian khusus.

options.text: An Amazon OpenSearch Service index fed from the source with an explicit freshness strategy.
options.explanation: Search index melayani pencarian dan agregasi; sinkronisasi dan lag harus dirancang.

question: A DynamoDB workload puts all current events under one partition-key value. Requests concentrate on that value even though table-wide capacity is sufficient. What should the design review prioritize?

options.text: Increase only total table capacity indefinitely without changing the concentrated access pattern.
options.explanation: Kapasitas tabel tidak otomatis mengatasi batas akses yang sangat terkonsentrasi.

options.text: Distribute writes using a suitable key or sharding strategy and account for read aggregation.
options.explanation: Key yang menyebarkan trafik mengurangi konsentrasi; biaya fan-out baca harus diperhitungkan.

options.text: Use the same constant partition key in a new GSI for all items.
options.explanation: Indeks dengan konsentrasi identik mempertahankan masalah hotspot.

options.text: Add a filter expression to every read so partition-key writes become distributed.
options.explanation: Filter baca tidak mengubah lokasi atau pola write.

question: Immediately after a DynamoDB write, a confirmation workflow must read the committed item without eventual-consistency lag. The item primary key is known. Its current read uses a GSI. Which change is appropriate?

options.text: Read the base table using its primary key with a strongly consistent read.
options.explanation: Tabel mendukung strong read; GSI tidak menawarkan pilihan strong read.

options.text: Set ConsistentRead to true on the GSI query.
options.explanation: GSI hanya menyediakan eventually consistent reads.

options.text: Increase GSI provisioned capacity as a guarantee of zero propagation lag.
options.explanation: Kapasitas tambahan bukan jaminan sinkronisasi kuat.

options.text: Add a TTL attribute to make the GSI update synchronous.
options.explanation: TTL tidak mengubah konsistensi propagasi indeks.

question: Thousands of clients request the same popular item just after its cache entry expires. They all rebuild it from the database simultaneously. Data can be stale for a bounded interval. Which design change addresses this pattern?

options.text: Remove all expiry and retain every cached value permanently.
options.explanation: Menghindari miss dengan data abadi melanggar batas freshness.

options.text: Coalesce concurrent refreshes for the key and use a controlled refresh/expiry policy within the freshness bound.
options.explanation: Satu refresh terkoordinasi mencegah banyak query identik sekaligus; freshness tetap dibatasi.

options.text: Give each simultaneous client a separate cache key for the same item.
options.explanation: Ini mengurangi reuse dan mempertahankan banyak query sumber.

options.text: Bypass the cache whenever many clients arrive.
options.explanation: Permintaan terkonsentrasi langsung dibebankan ke database.

question: Corporate DNS servers must resolve names in a Route 53 private hosted zone associated with a VPC. Private network routing is already in place. Which resolver direction is required?

options.text: Use VPC peering alone without configuring any DNS forwarding.
options.explanation: Konektivitas jaringan saja tidak membuat server DNS korporat mengetahui private zone.

options.text: Create Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoints and forward the relevant corporate DNS queries to them.
options.explanation: Query dari luar VPC masuk melalui inbound endpoint untuk resolusi nama VPC.

options.text: Create only outbound endpoints and send corporate queries to arbitrary EC2 instance addresses.
options.explanation: Outbound melayani arah VPC menuju DNS eksternal, bukan endpoint penerima ini.

options.text: Publish the private application records in a public hosted zone as the only solution.
options.explanation: Kebutuhan tidak mengharuskan publikasi nama ke publik.

question: Applications in several VPCs need to resolve corp.example using on-premises DNS. The accounts belong to one organization. Which design centralizes conditional forwarding while allowing participating VPCs to use it?

options.text: Associate a private hosted zone without records and expect automatic corporate forwarding.
options.explanation: Zone kosong bukan forwarding rule ke server korporat.

options.text: Use Resolver outbound endpoints, a rule for corp.example, and shared rule associations for the participating VPCs.
options.explanation: Outbound rule memilih domain yang diteruskan; sharing dan association memperluas penggunaan ke VPC yang diizinkan.

options.text: Create only inbound endpoints and expect them to initiate all VPC-to-corporate DNS forwarding.
options.explanation: Arah inbound tidak menggantikan outbound rule.

options.text: Copy every corporate DNS record to a public hosted zone daily.
options.explanation: Ini mempublikasikan data internal dan menambah sinkronisasi manual.

question: A VPC is associated with a private hosted zone for example.com. The public zone has api.example.com, but the private zone does not. VPC clients using the VPC resolver cannot resolve that name. What is the appropriate explanation and remedy?

options.text: The resolver always falls back to the public zone, so only an ALB health check can cause this.
options.explanation: Asumsi fallback tersebut tidak berlaku pada kondisi ini.

options.text: Increase the EC2 security-group outbound HTTP timeout.
options.explanation: Ketiadaan record pada zone yang dipilih bukan masalah timeout HTTP.

options.text: Enable S3 versioning to synchronize the two DNS zones.
options.explanation: Tidak ada hubungan sinkronisasi DNS melalui versioning S3.

options.text: The matching private zone takes precedence; add the required private record or redesign zone scope.
options.explanation: Resolver tidak otomatis mencari public zone ketika matching private zone tidak memiliki record yang diminta.

question: Dual-stack EC2 instances need to initiate IPv6 connections to internet services. Unsolicited inbound IPv6 connections must not be permitted through the internet path. Which gateway matches this requirement?

options.text: A NAT gateway selected solely to translate IPv6-to-IPv6 traffic.
options.explanation: Egress-only IGW adalah mekanisme yang tepat untuk IPv6-ke-IPv6 outbound-only.

options.text: An internet gateway alone while assuming IPv6 addresses are translated like private IPv4.
options.explanation: IPv6 routing melalui IGW tidak memberi asumsi NAT IPv4 tersebut.

options.text: An egress-only internet gateway with appropriate IPv6 routes and security rules.
options.explanation: Gateway ini stateful untuk outbound IPv6 dan mencegah inisiasi koneksi dari internet.

options.text: A virtual private gateway with no VPN or private connection.
options.explanation: Gateway VPN bukan jalur internet IPv6 outbound yang diminta.

question: Development and production VPCs attach to one transit gateway. Both need access to a shared-services VPC, but must not route directly to each other. Which design supports this routing policy?

options.text: Disable every route to shared services while leaving dev-prod routes present.
options.explanation: Ini kebalikan dari konektivitas yang diminta.

options.text: Create public DNS names only for shared services.
options.explanation: DNS tidak menghilangkan route jaringan dev-prod.

options.text: Use distinct transit gateway route tables with deliberate attachment associations and limited propagation/routes.
options.explanation: Pemisahan route table mengontrol jaringan mana yang dapat dicapai setiap attachment.

question: A team has Spark jobs and compatible libraries that process S3 datasets a few times daily. It wants an EMR runtime without maintaining an always-running cluster. Which option fits?

options.text: Amazon Quick Sight as the engine for executing arbitrary Spark transformations.
options.explanation: Layanan BI bukan runtime Spark untuk pipeline ini.

options.text: Amazon Athena as a guarantee that all existing Spark job code runs unchanged as SQL.
options.explanation: Athena SQL tidak otomatis menjalankan sembarang program Spark yang ada.

options.text: Amazon EMR Serverless with a supported release and suitable job runtime roles.
options.explanation: EMR Serverless menjalankan Spark tanpa mengoperasikan cluster; kompatibilitas release dan izin data tetap dicek.

options.text: An EMR on EC2 cluster kept at peak size between every job.
options.explanation: Dapat menjalankan Spark, tetapi tidak memenuhi tujuan menghindari cluster yang selalu dikelola.

question: New Parquet datasets arrive in S3. Analysts need table metadata for Athena, while a separate team manages access permissions. Which action discovers schema metadata without claiming to transform or authorize the data?

options.text: Run an appropriately configured Glue crawler to populate the Glue Data Catalog.
options.explanation: Crawler menemukan metadata; transformasi data dan izin akses tetap diatur terpisah.

options.text: Create a Quick Sight dashboard and assume it becomes the authoritative S3 storage engine.
options.explanation: Visualisasi tidak menggantikan storage atau katalog metadata.

options.text: Create a Lake Formation permission and assume it infers all new table schemas automatically.
options.explanation: Permission mengendalikan akses, bukan menggantikan discovery metadata.

options.text: Run only a Glue crawler and assume all malformed records are rewritten automatically.
options.explanation: Discovery metadata bukan proses ETL yang membersihkan setiap record.

question: A business dashboard can tolerate data that is up to one hour old. Many viewers run the same analytics and must not repeatedly load the source database. Which Quick Sight dataset approach should be evaluated?

options.text: Enable S3 versioning on an unrelated bucket instead of selecting a query mode.
options.explanation: Versioning tidak menentukan bagaimana dashboard membaca data sumber.

options.text: Use direct queries for every viewer and assume source load is eliminated.
options.explanation: Direct query tetap mengeksekusi query pada sumber sesuai pola penggunaan.

options.text: Import the dataset into SPICE and schedule refreshes that satisfy the freshness requirement.
options.explanation: SPICE melayani analitik dari data yang diimpor; refresh mengatur seberapa baru data tersedia.

options.text: Import once into SPICE and never refresh because the source is changing.
options.explanation: Tanpa refresh, data akan melewati batas umur satu jam.

question: A Kinesis producer assigns the same partition key to almost every event. A hot shard limits writes, while consumers have spare capacity. Which change addresses the underlying access pattern?

options.text: Increase only the event retention period.
options.explanation: Retensi tidak menyebarkan key yang panas.

options.text: Add more consumers but keep every write on the same partition key.
options.explanation: Reader tambahan tidak mengubah distribusi write producer.

options.text: Place every event into one larger payload and assume ordering and size constraints disappear.
options.explanation: Batching tidak menghilangkan seluruh batas maupun kebutuhan desain partition key.

options.text: Choose a more distributed partition-key scheme consistent with the required ordering scope.
options.explanation: Distribusi key menyebarkan write; perubahan urutan harus dinilai sebelum menerapkannya.

question: A supported Glue ETL source is processed daily. The team wants to avoid rereading previously processed inputs. It also wants to rerun a historical range safely when business logic changes. Which design is appropriate?

options.text: Disable all job state and identify new data only by the number of output files.
options.explanation: Jumlah file output bukan penanda kemajuan input yang andal.

options.text: Reset the bookmark every day and assume the job will read only new input.
options.explanation: Reset justru menghapus kemajuan yang dipakai membedakan input lama.

options.text: Use job bookmarks for incremental input and design idempotent output handling for deliberate reprocessing.
options.explanation: Bookmark melacak input; reset atau rewind tidak otomatis membersihkan output lama.

options.text: Use bookmarks as a guarantee that destination tables can never contain duplicates.
options.explanation: Output dan efek samping tetap membutuhkan desain idempotensi.
